svg.text: Back wall at the top, dining room at the bottom; left and right as you walk in from the road. Dashed red: canopy hood above.
Dashed blue: ceiling hatch and fridge door swings. Dashed grey: shelves above. Heights, exhaust and services: sheet 2.
Non-veg prep bench, undershelf, shelf over
Shelves over the dish line (top one slatted)
Wok tool rail: ladle, spatula, spider, brush
Ticket rail over the pass hatch
Apron hook rail on the door
Extinguishers: Class K 6 L, CO₂ 4.5 kg
Benches stainless steel 304, 0.90 m high; hot line 0.70 deep.
Kitchen 4.90 × 2.40 m inside; PVC ceiling at 2.70 m with a
storage deck above (1.7 m clear) reached by the hatch.
Sized to the 22-dish menu: Tangra Indo-Chinese wok dishes,
dim sum, bao, Korean bar food; about 60–80 covers a day.
Shelves over the dish line at 1.45 and 1.85 m: plates below,
steamer baskets air-dry on the slatted top shelf.
Positions are from the 3D model; check every wall and
pillar P2 on site before fabrication.
